title: Technical Product Manager - Recommendations
description:
**About Atlys**
---------------


Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.


Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.


Atlys is changing that.


We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries**. But we’re still early.

**The Role**
------------


We're looking for a **Technical Product Manager** to own data ingestion for Atlys Signals pod the team responsible for collecting, structuring and surfacing the real\-time signals that power Atlys' AI\-driven travel decisions.


You'll drive the pipelines, integrations and data quality that keep Signals reliable at scale.

**The Job**
-----------

* **Lead automation and AI/ML infrastructure initiatives** across data pipelines, model serving, evaluation and monitoring to build reliable, scalable systems.
* **Own end\-to\-end execution** across Engineering, Product, AI and Operations, driving initiatives from problem definition through delivery and impact measurement.
* **Translate complex technical and business requirements** into structured execution plans, accounting for AI constraints, dependencies, risks and scalability.
* **Track and improve AI system performance** through dashboards and metrics such as accuracy, latency, cost and model quality.
* **Drive cross\-functional alignment and responsible AI practices**, including guardrails, monitoring and human\-in\-the\-loop review.

**The Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------


You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 4 to 7 years as a Technical PM or Data PM, ideally owning data pipelines or ingestion systems
* Are comfortable with data architecture and APIs, ETL/ELT, schemas, data quality tooling etc.
* Are structured and detail\-oriented, able to prioritise across many sources and stakeholders.
* Are analytical, using pipeline and data\-quality metrics to guide decisions.
* Communicate well, aligning engineering, AI/ML and product teams around data needs.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*

**What you can expect**
-----------------------


Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.


Here’s what you can expect:

* **Competitive compensation and equity** so you participate in the value you help create.
* **Comprehensive health insurance** covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* **A thoughtful leave policy** with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* **Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office**, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* **Learning \& development credits** to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* **Relocation support** to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* **Great tools to do your best work**, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* **An office designed for more than just work**, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Account Manager
description:
**Company:** Aalekh.ai  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Location:** Delhi

**About the Role**

Aalekh.ai is looking for an **Account Manager** to build and manage strong relationships with our customers, including **CA firms, Chartered Accountants, SMEs, and finance teams**.

The role involves understanding customer requirements, ensuring successful onboarding and product adoption, resolving queries, and identifying opportunities for account growth and retention.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and maintain strong relationships with assigned customers.
* Understand customer requirements and ensure a smooth onboarding experience.
* Conduct product walkthroughs and assist customers with product adoption.
* Act as the primary point of contact for customer queries and concerns.
* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve customer issues effectively.
* Regularly engage with customers to understand their feedback and requirements.
* Monitor customer usage, satisfaction, and engagement.
* Identify opportunities for **upselling, cross\-selling, renewals, and referrals**.
* Maintain accurate customer and account information in the CRM.
* Prepare regular account updates and reports.
* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.

Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in **Finance, Commerce, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field**.
* 2–5 years of experience in **Account Management, Customer Success, Relationship Management, B2B SaaS, Fintech, or Financial Services**.
* Good understanding of finance and accounting concepts.
* Strong communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving and coordination abilities.
* Customer\-focused and proactive approach.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities effectively.
* Knowledge of **GST, Tally, accounting software, or SaaS products** is an added advantage.

**Why Join Aalekh AI?**

Join a growing **AI \& Fintech company** and work at the intersection of **Finance, Accounting, and Artificial Intelligence**, helping businesses and finance professionals adopt smarter and more efficient workflows.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Category Manager- Logistics & supply chain domain
description:
**Designation: Manager / Senior Manager – Intercity Programs**

**Location: Delhi NCR**

**Experience: 4\-7 years**

**About the Role:** As a Manager / Senior Manager – Intercity Programs ,you will play a vital role in defining and scaling the Product\-Market Fit (PMF) for Intercity Outstation offering across partner and customer ecosystems. The role will be responsible for identifying market opportunities, shaping the category strategy, strengthening the partner ecosystem, and driving cross\-functional execution to deliver sustainable business growth.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 

**Program \& Stakeholder Management:**

* Own program deliverables and drive execution across the project lifecycle.
* Manage key partnerships and coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely delivery.
* Work closely with Operations, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Business and Analytics teams to execute scalable solutions.

**Product\-Market Fit \& Category Development:**

* Drive the evolution of the Intercity Product\-Market Fit by identifying customer, partner and category needs.
* Conduct market research, data analysis and competitive assessment to identify growth opportunities.
* Develop and refine market offerings, operating models and strategies to strengthen the Intercity business.
* Identify and build the right partner ecosystem for the vertical.

**Commercial \& Operational Performance:**

* Optimize pricing strategies and supply onboarding processes for the Intercity vertical.
* Own key operational and business metrics and drive initiatives to improve business health, efficiency and growth.
* Analyze partner and customer behaviour to improve engagement, adoption and overall experience.
* Establish structured feedback loops and use data\-driven insights to continuously improve the business.

**Product Marketing \& Growth:**

* Ideate, launch and manage product marketing initiatives and campaigns to drive awareness, adoption and growth.
* Develop market\-facing propositions and align messaging with cross\-functional teams to maximize impact.
* Identify opportunities to improve product adoption and strengthen market positioning.

**Experimentation \& Continuous Improvement:**

* Design and execute rapid structural, operational and marketing experiments.
* Measure outcomes using relevant business and operational metrics.
* Translate learnings into actionable improvements and iterate quickly based on data and market feedback.

**Core Competencies:**

* Strong analytical, structured problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder\-management and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast\-paced and evolving business environments.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to balance short\-term execution with long\-term category strategy.
* Growth mindset, resilience and willingness to experiment, learn and iterate.
* Collaborative, proactive and execution\-oriented approach.

title: D2C Growth Executive
description:
**1\. Shopify Store (callas.in)**

▸ Manage the full Shopify storefront — product pages, collections, homepage, navigation, banners, sale events

▸ Ensure pricing, inventory sync, and dispatch notifications work correctly (Shiprocket integration)

▸ Own the conversion rate — page speed, product images, reviews, trust signals, checkout flow

▸ Create and manage discount codes for D2C\-exclusive offers (direct pricing advantage over Amazon's 15% commission)

▸ Set up and maintain a WhatsApp chat button for pre\-purchase queries (Indian furniture buyers ask before ₹5K\+ purchases)

**2\. Meta Ads (Facebook \+ Instagram)**

▸ Install and maintain Meta Pixel on callas.in for conversion tracking and retargeting

▸ Build and run ad campaigns: prospecting (cold audience, Advantage\+ Shopping), retargeting (site visitors, video viewers, Instagram engagers)

▸ Create ad creatives — product shots, room setups, assembly reels, price\-comparison graphics

▸ Manage monthly ad budget starting ₹50,000–1,00,000 with clear ROAS targets

▸ Run special campaigns around Amazon/Flipkart sale events to capture deal\-seeking traffic on callas.in

**3\. Instagram (@official.callas)**

▸ Post 3–4 reels per week: assembly time\-lapses, before/after room transformations, unboxing → assembled shots, customer testimonials

▸ Grow from current \~1,400 followers to 10,000\+ in 6 months through consistent content \+ paid promotion

▸ Set up Instagram Shopping (linked to Shopify via Meta Commerce Manager) so products are tappable in posts/reels

▸ Respond to DMs, comments, and inquiries promptly — this is a sales channel, not just branding

▸ Coordinate with factory team for raw content — you'll visit Bahalgarh periodically to shoot assembly/production footage

**4\. Google Shopping \+ SEO**

▸ Set up and manage Google Merchant Center via Shopify's Google channel app (catalog auto\-sync)

▸ Run Google Shopping ads on high\-intent keywords like 'study table under 5000', 'shoe rack with seating', 'DIY bed'

▸ Basic on\-page SEO — product titles, descriptions, blog posts targeting furniture buying queries

**5\. Other Channels**

▸ List top SKUs on Meesho for tier 2/3 city reach

▸ Manage a Callas YouTube channel — upload assembly videos, room setup ideas, product comparisons

▸ Create and maintain a 'Bulk Orders' page on callas.in for B2B/corporate inquiries (co\-living spaces, hostels, offices)

▸ Pinterest — pin room setup photos with product links

**Using Claude (AI) as a Core Work Tool**

This is non\-negotiable. We use Claude (by Anthropic) as a daily productivity tool across the business. You will be trained on it and expected to use it for:

**Ad copy \& content** — Listing optimization

▸ Upload Amazon/Flipkart keyword data → Claude analyzes gaps, rewrites titles, bullets, descriptions with the right keywords baked in

**PPC optimization** — Ad performance analysis

▸ Download weekly Search Term Reports, Campaign Reports → upload to Claude or the Callas Ops Console (internal tool) → get exact actions: which keywords to scale, which to negative\-match, which bids to change

**Content creation** — Creative briefing

▸ Use Claude to draft Instagram captions, ad copy variations, email sequences, blog posts, product descriptions — then edit for brand voice

**Market intelligence** — Competitor analysis

▸ Paste competitor listings, reviews, or Brand Analytics exports into Claude → get positioning insights, keyword gaps, content improvements

**Weekly summaries** — Reporting

▸ Use Claude to turn raw data (Shopify analytics, Meta ads dashboard, Google Analytics) into concise weekly reports with action items for the founder

You don't need prior experience with Claude specifically — we'll train you. But you must be comfortable working with AI tools, prompting them effectively, and integrating them into daily workflows rather than doing everything manually.

**RequirementsMust Have**

▸ 1–3 years of hands\-on experience running a Shopify or similar e\-commerce store

▸ Proven experience running Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad campaigns with measurable ROAS results — show us your numbers

▸ Working knowledge of Meta Business Suite, Ads Manager, Pixel setup, and audience building

▸ Basic design skills — Canva at minimum; Figma or Photoshop is a plus. You'll make creatives, not just brief them

▸ Comfortable with data — you'll read spreadsheets, ACOS/ROAS numbers, and weekly reports. No fear of numbers

▸ Strong written communication in English and Hindi — ad copy, captions, product descriptions

▸ Self\-starter mentality — you'll be the only person on this function. No one will tell you what to do each

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
